# hacienda - Zig Bindings

Bindings for hacienda

## Installation

Add to `build.zig.zon`:

```zig
.dependencies = .{
    .hacienda = .{ .url = "<tarball-url>" },
};
```

## Quick Start

```zig
const hacienda = @import("hacienda");

// Call generated wrapper functions; strings allocated by the FFI must
// be released with `hacienda._free_string`.
```

## Documentation

For full documentation, see the [hacienda repository](https://github.com/jamon8888/hacienda-engine).
